content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after each Save on the cap / floor screen, a visible error (app:36, app:43, app:50) appears, the user dismisses it with OK (328, 420), and then edits Notional (340, 387) before clicking Save again (362, 407), so the captured events suggest the error does not make the failing input clear enough to fix in one pass.", "fix": "Fix: On the cap / floor screen, change the Save click handler's validation failure path so it marks each invalid field with an inline message and moves focus to the first invalid field, instead of only showing the generic error dialog that is closed with the OK button.", "cited_event_ids": ["app:36", "app:43", "app:50", "328", "420", "340", "387", "362", "407"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["The text or target of the validation error is not in the events, so the specific failing rule and field cannot be confirmed.", "Whether the error is a modal dialog is inferred from the OK click position and timing, not from a recorded dialog event.", "The error events at 3385 and 12430 appear before Save was clicked, so their relation to the Save loop is unclear.", "Which field triggered the error on each attempt is not recorded; the edits to Notional are the only field edits between attempts in the loops 2 and 3, and loop 1 also edited Trade Date and Counterparty.", "The overlay shown/removed events after each Save are not labelled, so their purpose (for example a server call) is unknown."]}
